brief.goal: Implement the JSZC event-asset provision contract without enabling an unverified platform write.

allowed_writes: workflow skills, resource registry, execution-plan integration and focused smoke tests
idempotent database migration for the JSZC event-asset blueprint contract
Task, Manifest and project control-plane status
forbidden_actions: real platform write or event asset creation
token refresh, budget or bid changes
raw request, raw response, complete URL or credential persistence
modification of existing runtime Case, Job or Plan facts
validation_plan: run event-chain and new event-asset-provision focused smoke tests
run resource registry, execution-plan and workflow schedule regressions
verify no event-asset prepare action is compiled when the creation contract is unverified
run schema and source preflight checks
stop_conditions: The official 3.0 event-asset creation contract is unavailable or incomplete.
The template lacks a stable reference or hash.
Any implementation requires a real platform write.

before_any_write: A future Task must verify the official 3.0 create contract and grant a fresh, plan-bound single confirmation.
This Task grants no real platform action.

closure.next_task_requirement: Verify the official 3.0 event-asset create contract before enabling any executor or Plan action.
